experiment: Tracking Experiment T2 -- Modern Default Policy Follow-up

methodological_correction.correction: T2 must NOT be described as a new independent confirmation of CBIoUTracker or BoTSORTTracker accuracy. Their exact LIBRARY_DEFAULTS configurations have ALREADY been evaluated on EyeCU-Tracking-Val-v1.1, and those results are what generated the hypothesis T2 tests. Re-measuring accuracy on the same data cannot independently confirm a hypothesis that data produced.
what_t2_actually_adds: clean reproducibility of the recorded configurations and metrics
per-match robustness reporting rather than a pooled figure alone
controlled END-TO-END runtime, which the closed experiment never measured
methodological_correction.explicit: Passing T2 does NOT make its accuracy result independent confirmatory evidence. EyeCU-Tracking-Val-v1.1 remains development / model-selection data.

purpose: Qualify whether the exact modern library-default configurations that showed strong exploratory results are legitimate production candidates, on reproducibility, robustness, runtime and integration grounds.
closed_experiment_unchanged: experiments/tracking_v2/bakeoff/EXPERIMENT_RECORD.json -- production decision KEEP_LEGACY_SUPERVISION_BYTETRACK stands unless and until T2 concludes otherwise.

LEGACY_SUPERVISION_BYTETRACK.config: supervision==0.26.1 sv.ByteTrack() with NO arguments, driven via update_with_detections, fed the accepted store (>= 0.25), production output filter applied
LEGACY_SUPERVISION_BYTETRACK.not_normalised: its effective ~0.35 new-track gate stays as production has it

excluded_candidates.ByteTrackTracker: exploratory HOTA 55.78, within noise of the legacy 55.70 and far below the other two; not worth an experiment
excluded_candidates.OCSORTTracker: exploratory HOTA 47.27, clearly worse than legacy under both profiles

detections_supplied: the frozen candidate evidence store, confidence >= 0.01, exactly as in the LIBRARY_DEFAULTS runs. The detector is not re-run for accuracy metrics.

adoption_gate.rule: A candidate must satisfy ALL criteria. Any single failure is a FAIL.
adoption_gate.amendment_rule: No criterion may be altered, softened, reinterpreted or supplemented once execution begins. No tie-breaker may be added after results are visible.

1_reproducibility.requirement: The configuration must be exactly equivalent to the LIBRARY_DEFAULTS configuration recorded in the closed bake-off, verified MECHANICALLY against the preserved instantiated-object configs, not against documentation.
1_reproducibility.on_drift: STOP qualification for that candidate and investigate reproducibility.
1_reproducibility.forbidden: averaging away the discrepancy, or widening the tolerance after seeing the drift

2_combined_HOTA.requirement: COMBINED_SEQ HOTA improvement >= +2.0 absolute vs LEGACY_SUPERVISION_BYTETRACK

3_combined_AssA.requirement: COMBINED_SEQ AssA improvement >= +3.0 absolute vs legacy

4_combined_IDF1.requirement: COMBINED_SEQ IDF1 improvement >= +3.0 absolute vs legacy
4_combined_IDF1.why_stricter_than_the_closed_experiment: T2 exists because the exploratory default configurations showed substantial identity-association improvement. Merely avoiding IDF1 regression is not sufficient to qualify; the candidate has to deliver the thing that motivated the experiment.

5_per_match_HOTA_robustness.requirement: HOTA improves vs legacy in >= 2 of the 3 independent matches, AND no individual match regresses by more than 2.0 absolute HOTA

6_per_match_identity_robustness.requirement: No individual match regresses by more than 2.0 absolute IDF1
6_per_match_identity_robustness.diagnostics_status: EXPLANATORY ONLY. No additional threshold may be created from these numbers after results are seen.

7_eyecu_invariants.requirement: All of the following must hold; any failure is a FAIL.
invariants: ball completely isolated from human tracking
no duplicate tracker identity within a frame
no hidden detector rerun and no GT filtering of detections

8_controlled_end_to_end_runtime.requirement: Candidate TOTAL pipeline runtime regression <= +10% vs production legacy
forbidden: satisfying this criterion with tracker-side runtime alone
reusing any previous contaminated runtime measurement, including the earlier +37% figure

9_no_tuning.requirement: CBIoU and BoTSORT must remain their EXACT recorded 2.6.0 defaults.
forbidden: any parameter selected after looking at T2 metrics

selection_rule.one_candidate_passes_all: select that candidate for tracker freeze
selection_rule.both_pass: the candidate with the higher COMBINED_SEQ HOTA wins
selection_rule.both_pass_and_HOTA_within_0.5: the candidate with the lower controlled END-TO-END ms/frame wins
selection_rule.status: ENGINEERING DEVELOPMENT RULE, defined after exploratory VAL results
selection_rule.explicit: This selection rule must NOT be represented as independent scientific confirmation. It decides an engineering question on development data.

predeclared_questions.A_reproducibility: Are the default CBIoU / BoTSORT results reproducible from a clean rerun, from the same frozen detections, in a freshly created isolated environment, within the criterion-1 tolerance?
predeclared_questions.B_source_of_gain: Where does any gain come from -- DetA, AssA, or both? Report the decomposition per tracker and per sequence.
predeclared_questions.C_per_match_consistency: Do they improve at least 2 of the 3 individual matches, or only the pooled COMBINED_SEQ? A pooled gain carried by one sequence is not a robust gain.
predeclared_questions.D_runtime: Do the identity gains survive controlled END-TO-END runtime measurement? BoTSORT measured +110.6% tracker-side in the closed experiment, so this is a live risk for it specifically.
predeclared_questions.E_invariants: Are EyeCU semantic, output and ball invariants preserved under real pipeline integration?
predeclared_questions.F_cmc_contribution: Does BoTSORT's CMC materially contribute to its result? RECORDED AS A FUTURE MECHANISTIC QUESTION ONLY. Do NOT ablate CMC in T2 -- the production-candidate experiment must use exact defaults, and an ablation would make the candidate something other than the configuration being judged.

also_reported: per-sequence values for all three matches
unweighted macro mean as a descriptive robustness check
metrics.evaluation: pinned TrackEval 1.3.0 vendored copy, MotChallenge2DBox, DO_PREPROC False, alpha thresholds unchanged

validation_set_status_warning: T2 runs on EyeCU-Tracking-Val-v1.1, which is a development / model-selection benchmark. A T2 pass qualifies a candidate for engineering adoption; it is not final confirmation and must never be reported as one.

test_split.may_not: be used to choose between CBIoU and BoTSORT, or between any candidates
test_split.may_only_be_evaluated: once, as final system confirmation, after the tracker, its configuration, and all remaining EyeCU system decisions are frozen
